name: The town elder
notes: dusk16: a robe, long ash hair, moss cloth, dark skin. The tunic keeps her out of the trousers-and-coat silhouette every other adult wears. Indigo rather than the moss dusk16 gave her, because Rook wears moss and the two of them side by side were a woman in a green tunic twice - the palette is the same family, the reading is not.
